besluite.fout: The gapped clause after a comma ('die Oos-Kaap, die Vredefortkoepel in die Vrystaat') can be misread on a first pass as a further item in the Kaapse blommeryk's list of places.
besluite.rede: Splitting into a separate sentence with its own verb matches the neighbouring sentences, removes the stumble, keeps every protected name intact and moves no meaning.
